text: Fixed: `dayjs.tz(timestamp | Date | Dayjs, tz)` now delegates to `dayjs(input).tz(tz)` instead of treating the value as a wall-clock string. Verified against moment-timezone for timestamps, Dates and Dayjs objects across many zones/DST boundaries; full suite still green (524/524).
Investigating the timezone plugin's `format('Z')` behaviour now; will report when fixed.
Found it: `src/locale/nl.js` has `ordinal: n => `${n}.``, but the Dutch ordinal is `1ste/2de/3de/8ste/20ste...`. Fixing and verifying against moment's nl locale.
Looking at `src/plugin/weekYear/index.js` for the `yearStart: 4` case now.

Fixed. Root cause: `proto.tz` computed `diff = (this.toDate() - new Date(target)) / 1000 / 60` without rounding, so the instance's milliseconds leaked into the offset — e.g. `dayjs().tz('America/New_York').format('Z')` returned `-04:0.011249999999989768` instead of `-04:00` (and `format()`/`utcOffset()` were wrong too). Now rounded: `Math.round(...)`, so `format('Z')`/`format('ZZ')`/`utcOffset()` are whole minutes for converted instances.

Fixed: `src/locale/nl.js` ordinal was `${n}.`; Dutch ordinals are `1ste/2de/3de/…/8ste/20ste…`, so it is now `[${n}${n === 1 || n === 8 || n >= 20 ? 'ste' : 'de'}]` (brackets escape the suffix from the format tokens). Verified `Do` for days 1–31 and `wo` for 52 weeks against moment's `nl` locale — all match.

Fixed: `weekYear()` only handled the "December belongs to next week-year" case. Added the missing branch `if (month === 0 && weekOfYear >= 52) return year - 1`, so early-January dates in week 52/53 of the previous year report the previous week-year (e.g. `2016-01-01` with `yearStart: 4` → 2015). Verified against moment for en, en-gb, zh-cn, fr, cs over 2014–2022 — no mismatches.

Fixed: the `A`/`a` tokens in `src/plugin/customParseFormat/index.js` hard-coded `/[AP]M/` and `input === 'PM'`, so localized meridiems could not be parsed. Added a `meridiemMatch(input, isLowerCase)` helper that uses the locale's `meridiem()` function (falling back to AM/PM), and switched both tokens to the word matcher. Verified AM/PM parsing for zh-cn, ja, ko, br and default en against moment.

Fixed: `unitToMS` in `src/plugin/duration/index.js` had no `milliseconds` entry, so `dayjs.duration(1, 'milliseconds')` produced `NaN` (rendered as `P0D`) and `.milliseconds()`/`.asMilliseconds()` were NaN. Added `milliseconds: 1`; `dayjs.duration(1, 'milliseconds').toISOString()` is now `PT0.001S`, `duration(1000,'milliseconds')` → `PT1S`, and `add(500,'milliseconds')` works.
